details: A slender sapling grows here, standing about waist high.  It has smooth gray bark and one or two thin stems rising from a common base.

seasonDetails.winter: The slim, reddish-brown twigs end in narrow, pointed buds sheathed in several overlapping scales.
seasonDetails.spring: The young leaves are oval to nearly round with blunt tips, coarsely toothed above the middle and smooth-edged below, and faintly downy on their undersides.  The sapling is still too young to flower.
seasonDetails.summer: The leaves are oval to nearly round, dull blue-green above and paler beneath, with coarse teeth along the upper half of each margin.
seasonDetails.fall: The yellow and orange leaves are oval to nearly round, with coarse teeth along the upper half of each margin.
